title: Assistant Dean of Student Engagement and Leadership
bio: As Assistant Dean of Student Engagement and Leadership, I work with the Student Engagement team to support student involvement initiatives on-campus. From advising the Harvard Undergraduate Association to working with student organizations, I work with students to create opportunities to create a vibrant community outside the classroom. I am here for students interested in getting involved with the Harvard Undergraduate Association, student organizations, and leadership development opportunities on campus. In my spare time, I enjoy spending time with my wife, our daughter, and our black lab, Merry. Some of my interests include supporting Boston's professional teams, perfecting my mediocre golf game, and traveling. Area Student Engagement Role Central
